notes.content: Fixed a bug where a confirmation message would appear even when the graphics settings had not been changed

Partial modification of Colosseum terrain
Fixed a bug where the host migration HUD would not disappear even after returning to the title screen.
Fixed a bug where the game would freeze when host migration was executed.

Partially changed collision in Colosseo.
Changed so that UI is displayed when rehosting or reconnecting.

Implemented host migration.
Changed interaction from camera to character radius.
Fixed a bug where damage detection was disappearing near Big Carrot.
Partially changed the Colosseum terrain.
Suppressed camera shake when sprinting.
Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze when updating rooms.
Fixed a bug that caused characters to become unable to move upon revival.

The server now continues even if the host leaves.
Fixed a bug where achievements that did not meet the conditions were unlocked.
Changed the attack power limit (100 or higher is now 99).
Attack detection has been greatly increased.
Big carrots are now more likely to spawn in the forest.
Changed the time until big carrots disappear (120 to 200 seconds).

Fixed a bug where icons were not applied.
Fixed a bug where the UI would not display in the Colosseum.
Changed the value when ping was not obtained correctly.
Fixed a bug where achievements were unlocked even when conditions were not met.

Changed how large food items are handled.
Fixed a bug that caused characters to become immobile after eating large food items.
Slightly expanded attack detection range.
Added a cap to attack power (values above 1000 are now capped at 999).
Removed the ability to open options with the F12 key.
Operation instructions can now be viewed from the Marmot SHOP.
Changed some of the wording in the operation instructions.
Changed some collisions.

*You will not be able to enter servers created before this update.
Fixed a bug that prevented more than 16 people from entering the server (second time).

Fixed a bug where guns were displayed at spawn.
Improved UI.
Fixed a bug where more than 16 people could not enter the server.

Relaxed movement speed decrease when eating white, round objects 
Changed size of white, round objects 
Adjusted movement speed when eating food 
Changed rigidity when eating large food 
Fixed variable handling in client 
Fixed synchronization handling in coloseo 
Removed cross key manipulation
